pinout.notes: Combo high-side + low-side FET in one package (NexFET PowerBlock). Pinout per datasheet.

typical_applications: Laptop/desktop CPU VRM phase power stage
verification_notes: Family, package, VDS rating verified. Combo part: high-side + low-side in one package; do not treat as a single discrete FET.
replacement_notes: PowerBlock combo parts are only directly substitutable with another combo part of the same pinout, VDS, RDS_on, and Qg. Replacing with two discretes requires board layout changes.
